runtimeResult.message: Headless execution requires clarification before a repository plan can be created.

promptUnderstanding.reply: The requested rebuild conflicts with the read-only scope, the prohibition on all writer paths, and protection of `.git/**`. Please provide an authorized writable scope and confirm whether repository history may be changed.
promptUnderstanding.conversationSummary: The request asks to delete repository history and rebuild the project, while also declaring a read-only scope, no allowed writer paths, protected `.git/**`, and no other file modifications. No repository work is authorized until this conflict is resolved.

refinedBrief.goal: Rebuild the project from scratch and remove repository history, subject to explicit authorization.
deliverables: A rebuilt project within an explicitly authorized writable scope.
constraints: Current input declares no allowed writer paths.
Current input declares the task read-only.
Run `bun test` only if execution becomes authorized and appropriate.
acceptanceCriteria: An authorized scope, history policy, and validation requirement are confirmed before work begins.
nonGoals: Do not modify files under the current read-only authorization.
Do not change protected paths without explicit replacement authorization.

questions.prompt: Which authorized scope should govern this request?
questions.rationale: Deleting history or rebuilding a project requires writes, but the supplied constraints prohibit every write and protect `.git/**`.

options.label: Keep read-only
options.description: No repository changes will be made; Orynt can only provide a non-executing response.

options.label: Authorize rebuild
options.description: Provide writable project paths while keeping `.git/**` protected.

options.label: Authorize both
options.description: Explicitly authorize the exact repository-history operation and writable project paths.
